summary: Retain phase, process and daemon evidence when the fleet-leave fixture stalls

replay.detail: Only the fleet-leave test fixture changes.

schema.detail: No claim, registry or storage schema change.

rules.detail: The fixture keeps its existing assertions and operations; a stalled run fails after an external ten-minute diagnostic deadline.

compatibility.detail: No production behavior, admission or client contract change.

downtime.detail: Test diagnostics require no deployment or restart.

manual.detail: No user configuration or setup change.

recovery.detail: The existing test guardian still owns and reaps fixture processes; no product recovery change.
